built a houſe, and pitched his tents, he called the name of that place
Socoth, that is. Taberhacles. 18. and he paſſed into Salem a citie of
the Sichimites, which is in the land of Chanaan, after he returned
from Meſopotamia of Siria: and he dwelt belide the towne. 10. And
he bought that part of the field, wherin he had pitched his tents, of the
children of Hemor, the father of Sichem, tor an hundrec lambs.
.And crecting an altar there, on it he called vpon the moſt Mightie
God of Iſrael.
